pages.text: “Vines brimming with life, stretching muscles, relieving fatigue, and lightening one's steps.”$(br2)Kudzu Soup is a revitalizing medicinal broth made from dried kudzu root and sugar. The pale yellow tea has a mild and sweet taste. Drinking it grants a Speed boost and removes Mining Fatigue, helping travelers regain energy.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Kudzu Soup, $(br)boil two portions of dried kudzu root with sugar.$(br)It is perfect for consumption after long journeys or labor, helping travelers restore their energy.

Upon drinking Kudzu Soup, travelers receive a Speed boost and have Mining Fatigue removed, making work and movement easier.$(br)This tea is ideal for recovery after prolonged exertion.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
